ThingDef.label: burra
ThingDef.description: Burra fish were a species of bottom feeding predatory fish native to the planet of Dathomir. Their large size means they provide more nutrition than most fish.

ThingDef.label: dactopus
ThingDef.description: Dactopus were a cephalopod native to the planet Dac (homeworld of the Mon Calamari and Quarren people). Their small size meant they were used as an accompliment ingredient in several dishes.

ThingDef.label: daggert
ThingDef.description: The 'mee' (also known as a 'daggert') were a poisonous scalefish native to the waters of the planet of Naboo. The mee was rotund yet flat, with black-and-yellow scales and a set of poisonous spines that protruded from its centerline. With its diagonal striping pattern, it could camouflage itself and blend into its surroundings, such as sea grasses and reeds.

ThingDef.label: doshian jelly
ThingDef.description: 'Doshian jelly' or 'Doshian jellyfish' were marine invertebrates native to the planet Trandosha. They were widely considered to be the Trandoshan's favorite food but were nutritionally poor.

ThingDef.label: faa
ThingDef.description: The 'faa' (or 'faynaa' as they were known to the Gungan species), were fast-moving, predatory scalefish native to the oceans and swamps of the planets Naboo and Manaan.

ThingDef.label: fleek eel
ThingDef.description: The fleek eels were a species of eel with gray skin, a defined dorsal ridge and a pink, fleshy opening to their buccal tunnel. Most species considered it a delicacy. They could be found in the oceans of the planet Corellia and were caught by the fishermen of Coronet City, where they were a staple of the city's fishmarkets. They were also fished in the Hocekureem Sea on Falleen.

ThingDef.label: Laa
ThingDef.description: The laa was a scalefish native to the oceans of the planet Naboo. The typical laa was a green-scaled fish with a long snout and a broad tail. The laa also had a long, thin dorsal fin tipped with a bio-luminescent bulb. This bulb helped attract the favorite prey of the laa, the yobshrimp.

ThingDef.label: nyork
ThingDef.description: The nyork was a small, hard-shelled, carnivorous clam native to the swamps of the planet Naboo. They "nipped" with their mouths located inside their shells, and would jump out of the water at whatever seemed to be prey to them.

ThingDef.label: paddy frog
ThingDef.description: The paddy frog (or 'Klatooine paddy frog') was a species of aggressive aquatic frog from the planet Klatooine. It possessed external tentacle-like gills to aid it in breathing underwater and were a popular dietary favourite of the Hutt species.

ThingDef.label: ray
ThingDef.description: The ray were a large predatory scalefish native to the oceans of the planet Naboo (and after being introduced there, Naboo's moon Ohma-D'un). Rays were considered fast swimmers and impressive leapers due to a pronounced crescent-shaped caudal fin located at the back of their bodies.

ThingDef.label: see
ThingDef.description: The 'see' (also known as a 'binocular fish') was a predatory scalefish native to the oceans of the planet Naboo. It was a long thin fish that possessed large blue eyes and a stomach that could distend to accommodate larger meals. With these eyes, the see was capable of binocular vision.

ThingDef.label: sink-crab
ThingDef.description: The sink-crab was an aquatic crustacean native to the oceans of the planet Bestine IV. It used bladders on it's back that filled with air to float and propel itself through the water; allowing easy grazing on algae or kelp columns. Their large size and shells made them heavy when carried outside of water.
